title: Last War Command

steps.text: Save the rest (~9,400) for Marshall skill 1 21 to 22
Williams cannon 30 to 40, then data chip 30 to 40
Season screen checked: boost is Scarlett only, nothing for Squad 1
Wall of Honor: Stetmann (0), Marshall (10), Williams (11) first
Tonight: start the longest Tank Mastery nodes in both research queues; don't speed them up yet
Research day: finish them with research speedups, during Arms Race's Technology window if you can
Then finish the Alliance Duel tree (96%): it raises your duel points every week
Gear stars: Marshall, then Williams, then Stetmann
Tank Mastery research: keep both queues busy between research days
Kimberly Exclusive Weapon 20 to 30; Marshall's if he has one

rules: Squad 1 power is about 20.3M from the five heroes plus about 9.3M from troops. The troop part is capped while HQ stays at 30, so growth has to come from the heroes.
Skill medals go to skill 1 first: it is each tank's main attack and gives the most damage per medal.
Exclusive Weapon shards go to one weapon until level 20 before starting another. Never Tesla.
Filling troop slots raises total power, not Squad 1 power. Still worth doing, just not for this goal.
Light spend priority: season pass for weapon shards, then gear blueprint packs on sale.

recaps.title: Baseline and the 40M plan
recaps.sources: 4 videos + skills video + Season Boost screenshot
highlights: First full snapshot: 137.6M total power, 31 heroes, 3 squads (29.56M / 19.60M / 21.51M).
Kimberly (4.94M) is the benchmark. Williams, Stetmann and Marshall trail her by 1.3M to 1.6M each.
Williams is the softest front-liner: 27% damage resistance against 50% for Murphy.
All four skills read for each tank. Skill 4 is maxed on everyone; skill 1 is the best medal value.
Season 3 boost is Scarlett only (5% less monster damage). Use her for zombie and monster fights.
recaps.next: Finish Phase 1, then record the Squad 1 screen and each tank's main page so we can measure the gain.
